title: Peter's Confession and Jesus' First Passion Prediction
description: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter confesses that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of the living God. Jesus calls him the rock and promises him the keys to the kingdom of heaven. Then he tells his disciples for the first time that he must go to Jerusalem, suffer, die, and rise on the third day. When Peter objects, Jesus rebukes him sharply and teaches the disciples to take up their cross and follow him. [ref:Matt 16:13-28|Matthew 16:13-28]
